This Application has been filed for quashing the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.53 of 2023,
pending before the court of learned Judicial Magistrate/ Additional Civil Judge (Junior Division),
Bazpur, District Udham Singh Nagar under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.

entities.text:
Judicial Magistrate/ Additional Civil Judge (Junior Division),
Bazpur, District Udham Singh Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Mr. Harshit Sanwal, learned counsel for the applicant-accused.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant- accused submitted that the applicant has filed a petition under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.
The said petition is still pending.
4. Notice is being issued to the respondent.
Steps to be taken within a week.
Till then, the further proceedings of the said Criminal Case No.53 of 2023 are stayed.
6. The applicant and the respondent are directed to appear in-person before this Court on 03.12.2025 at 10:30 a.m. (Alok Kumar Verma, J.)
